about.en: BWET is the Breakwave Tanker Shipping ETF, sponsored by Amplify Investments and tracking the Breakwave Tanker Futures Index, a portfolio of crude oil tanker freight futures (around 90% TD3C very large crude carrier contracts and 10% TD20 Suezmax contracts) with a weighted average expiry of 60 to 90 days. Its shares trade on NYSE Arca as BWET.
